_comment: Permissions do not travel with a Claude Code plugin. Merge this block into the .claude/settings.json of any project where CASA is installed. It allows the read-only analysis commands the specialists use, denies destructive commands and network tools in Bash, and keeps secrets unreadable. It also allows reads under ~/.claude/plugins, where the skills' templates and reference tables live after a marketplace install; a checkout-path install needs that checkout's path allowed too, which scripts/install-into-project.sh adds.
